explication: LocalAGI is a self-hosted platform for configuring local AI agents, interacting with them through chat and APIs, and extending them with actions, connectors, skills, scheduled work, and knowledge collections. The main user journey is: configure an agent in the web UI, persist and start it in the agent pool, send it a request, and receive streamed results. The graph preserves README-documented features whose implementation was not sampled; those links are documented or marked unverified rather than implying source inspection.
